reason: AO cannot index client documents for embedding retrieval. See docs/ao-gaps.md item 3.

label: Novelty check by model judge over titles and excerpts
Quotes verified as exact substrings on the server
reason: Needs the aoq_quote_verifier deterministic agent installed on the AO server.

label: Word n-gram originality on the server
reason: Needs the aoq_text_checks deterministic agent installed on the AO server.

label: Image reuse from the media library, judged by a vision agent
Stock image search (Openverse, Wikimedia Commons)
reason: Served by the worker (client.aoq_images) over the AO Reach tunnel. Licenses limited to CC0, public domain, CC BY and CC BY-SA; license and attribution come from the provider, not the model.

label: Web image search through SearXNG (all engines)
reason: Served by the worker. Licenses are not checked: each image is linked to the page it was found on and marked license unchecked (D28).

label: AI generated images
reason: AO has no image generation, and no generation service is available to serve from the worker. See docs/ao-gaps.md item 5.

label: AO harness profiles and impartial QA on QA passes
reason: AO JSON mode does not apply harness profiles or impartial QA to direct_agent calls.

label: Token usage and cost in the run log
reason: AO records usage server side but does not return it to Reach clients.

label: Read-only abilities over the WordPress MCP Adapter
reason: Read-only abilities are flagged public for MCP. The MCP Adapter is not installed on the site.
